query:
SELECT e.turn_id, string_agg(e.payload->>'text','' ORDER BY e.sequence) AS "text!"
        FROM turn_events e
        JOIN chat_turns t ON t.id=e.turn_id
        WHERE e.turn_id=ANY($1) AND t.status IN ('queued','running','delegated') AND e.payload->>'kind'='text_delta'
        GROUP BY e.turn_id
